title: Standing Order: Thin the Pack
description: The wolds never stay quiet for long — the packs breed back as fast as they're culled. The village keeps a standing bounty posted for anyone willing to keep the treeline thinned. Bring a tally of gray wolves whenever you've the time; it pays out every time, so it's worth a swing between the longer errands.
location_hint: The treeline north of the village.

objectives.desc: Cull gray wolves from the treeline
